title: {{NAME}} and the Big Dino Soccer Day
moral: Playing together is better than playing alone.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} kicked his soccer ball down the path.
The path led to a wide sunny field.
Fluffy rabbits and foxes played in the grass.
A big purple dinosaur sat at one end.
He was watching the empty soccer goal.
